subject: [RFC PATCH 5/7] cgroup: take set_active_cgroup() time out of the cgroup's cpu.max

2026-09-24.patch_summary: This patch modifies the set_active_cgroup() function to charge kernel time used by tasks to their current cgroup's cpu.max quota, in addition to updating the task's active cgroup. This ensures that CPU usage is accurately accounted for and reflected in the cgroup's statistics. The change involves storing the task's runtime at each set_active_cgroup() call and then charging the old cgroup with the used time when the active cgroup changes.
